decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible through efficient and direct burn spells, aided by creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent by constantly threatening them with damage and utilizing cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel to punish them for playing spells. The mana base is optimized for fast, consistent plays to ensure the deck can utilize its spells effectively and maximize its potential for fast wins.

The main focus of this deck is to apply heavy pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By combining creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Grief also adds disruption to the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's mana base and gain an advantage. Overall, this deck aims to close out games as quickly as possible through aggro tactics.

This deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip powerful artifacts like Kaldra Compleat and Nettlecyst onto creatures for a powerful and quick win condition. The deck also includes protection and ramp elements with cards like Giver of Runes, Spell Pierce, and Urza's Saga. By utilizing these cards effectively, players can quickly overwhelm their opponent with a strong board presence and efficient use of mana resources.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Colossus Hammer combo quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid, players can equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature for a massive power boost. The deck also includes protection with cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, as well as utility lands like Urza's Saga. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a giant, unblockable creature wielding Colossus Hammer and close out the game before they have a chance to respond.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Underworld Breach with Grinding Station or Thassa's Oracle to win the game. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help with recurring artifacts from the graveyard to keep the combo going. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides card advantage and mana ramp. Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga help with finding key pieces of the combo. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and removal spells like Unholy Heat and Galvanic Blast to control the game until the combo can be assembled and executed.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal large amounts of damage in a short amount of time. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the hammer, along with support from cards like Sigarda's Aid and Giver of Runes for protection, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful, fast-paced offensive strategy. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to help find key artifacts and lands to further enhance its combo potential.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. It also takes advantage of the graveyard with cards such as Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to create value. The deck includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board, while also using powerful cards like Tourach, Dread Cantor and Fury to maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to quickly establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for powerful plays such as casting massive Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine, or using Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board. The deck also includes various colorless mana sources and artifact synergies to support the Tron lands strategy, along with disruption tools like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to control the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Underworld Breach along with fast mana rocks like Mox Amber and Urza's Saga to loop through spells from the graveyard, eventually winning the game by milling the opponent with Grinding Station and Thassa's Oracle or dealing direct damage with Unholy Heat. The deck includes various cards that support the combo like Mishra's Bauble for card advantage and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for additional mana generation. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo from disruption, making it a powerful and efficient deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck aims to assemble a powerful combo using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to mill through the deck, generate mana with Mox Amber and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and ultimately win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes efficient card selection and card advantage tools like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, along with disruption from cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. Urza's Saga offers flexibility in searching for key combo pieces, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional card advantage. The deck is designed to be a fast and consistent threat in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to create an aggressive strategy focused on casting cascade spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck can create a fast and efficient board presence. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation offers additional disruption and protection. The deck also features a diverse mana base with lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Leyline Binding to support the cascade mechanic.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of removal, disruption, and efficient creatures to quickly defeat the opponent. It includes a variety of powerful spells like Unholy Heat, Lightning Bolt, and Terminate to remove threats, while also utilizing cards like Liliana of the Veil and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's hand. The deck's creatures, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf, provide a strong early-game presence and can quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes various lands and artifacts to support its strategy.

The deck aims to quickly cycle through its creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan, eventually casting Living End to bring all creatures back from the graveyard. It utilizes cards like Street Wraith and Grief to cycle through the deck efficiently and cards like Architects of Will to control the opponent's draws. Colossal Skyturtle serves as a win condition with its flying and hexproof abilities. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect its combo. The mana base includes a variety of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also features graveyard interaction with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Seasoned Pyromancer. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides extra card advantage, while cards like Grief and Fury help to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency in casting spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption, using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, and Thoughtseize to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief allow for hand disruption and graveyard interaction, while removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt handle threats on the board. The deck also includes some protection with Feign Death and Undying Malice, as well as some utility with cards like Kolaghan's Command and Agadeem's Awakening. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while controlling the game tempo.

The main concept of the deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats, as well as disruption like Unholy Heat and Dauthi Voidwalker. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Liliana of the Veil and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to grind out value and finish off opponents. The inclusion of Blood Moon also helps disrupt the opponent's mana base.
